title: Save (local profile)
description: Stored in localStorage. Every unlock in design §10 must be computable from these counters and results. Deterministic and visible: no random unlocks.

ultraTurbos.description: Tier-3 drift boosts fired, all modes

timeTrial.description: Keyed by trackId. Best time at 150cc, its medal, the best run's ghost path and its time at each lap line.

ghost.description: The best run as a path, not inputs (an input replay drifts: race-manager Decisions 2026-09-21): position, heading and loop angle every 4 sim ticks, varint deltas, base64 (src/race-manager/ghost.ts). Replaced only with a new best.

paint.description: The alt paint the best run was set in (absent: the racer's own colours); the ghost is drawn in it. Kept only with a ghost, and only a paint of that racer.

body.description: The shared body the best run was set in (absent: the signature kart); the ghost is drawn on it. Kept only with a ghost.

splitsMs.description: The best run's time at each lap line from the start (cumulative ms, rising; the last is bestMs). A run shows its time at each line against these (ui-hud: the lap pop by the timer). Replaced only with a new best; absent for a best set before 25 Sept 2026.

unlocked.description: Cache of unlockable ids already granted, so the reveal fires once. Unknown ids are dropped on load.

autoAccelerate.description: Auto-accelerate: the gas down by itself from GO (src/game/assist.ts). Never in the countdown, so the start boost stays the player's own press on the 2; the brake still brakes and reverses. Changes the player's input before it is logged, so a run replays the same.

steeringAssist.description: Steering assist: nudges the kart back from the road's edge and away from open drops (src/game/assist.ts); strong input toward an edge wins, except before a drop. Changes the player's input before it is logged, so a run replays the same.

iconLabels.description: a letter on every item icon, on top of shape and colour

selectedBodyId.description: The kart body every racer drives (cosmetic only: the racer owns the class). On load, a body not in unlocked.bodies falls back to standard.

skinByRacer.description: Each racer's alt paint, by racer id (absent: their own colours). On load, an entry is kept only when the racer exists, the paint is theirs and it is in unlocked.skins. Replaces selectedSkinId (one paint could not remember two racers').
